description:
The primitive-polynomial verifier in `crates/gf2-core/src/primitive_polys.rs` stores polynomials in `u64`, which bounds the degrees it verifies.

## Background

The module documentation named the widening as an extension; the source-comment sweep removed that statement, and this issue tracks it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `verify_primitive` accepts polynomials in `u128` storage, or the supported degree bound is stated as a present-tense contract in its Rustdoc and enforced by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: Verification results for every catalogued polynomial are unchanged, shown by a test over the catalogue.
title: Widen verify_primitive to u128 polynomial storage
